source: Programme Guide 2026 (EN, Version 1, 12/11/2025) Part B, Mobility of Youth Workers; form structure observed from the 2026 official application environment (encoded by hand, not scraped).

eligibility.source: Guide 2026, Mobility projects for youth workers

annexes.label: Day-by-day timetable
annexes.description: Detailed timetable by day and session for every professional development activity.

annexes.label: APV session programme
annexes.description: Required if a preparatory visit is requested. Reviewers will not fund an APV without a session plan.

fields.label: Project summary
fields.question: In a few sentences, what is this youth-worker mobility about?
fields.helpText: Name the organisations, who takes part (youth workers, not young people), and the professional need it answers.

fields.label: Applicant organisation
fields.question: Who is applying? Organisation type, country, and what youth work you already do.
fields.helpText: The applicant profile must be relevant to youth work — Guide 2026 Relevance criterion.

fields.label: Participating organisations
fields.question: Who are the partner organisations, and how many are they (including you)?
fields.helpText: At least two organisations from different countries. State sending/receiving roles. Do not invent a host.

fields.label: Countries
fields.question: Which countries take part?
fields.helpText: List the countries of participating organisations. The venue must be in one of these.

fields.label: Primary participants
fields.question: Who are the primary participants of the activity itself?
fields.helpText: For KA153 this must be youth workers, not young people. Young people benefit afterwards through better youth work.

options.label: Youth workers / youth-work staff of the participating organisations
Young people (typically 13–30) as the course participants
A mix — you will explain in the profile answer

fields.label: Needs analysis
fields.question: What development needs of youth workers and their organisations does this respond to?
fields.helpText: Needs must be at youth-worker and organisation level, not “young people use social media”. Evidence per participating organisation.

fields.label: Needs method
fields.question: How did you identify those needs?
fields.helpText: Name a method. “We know from experience” is not enough.

options.label: A mix of survey, interviews, and organisational records

fields.label: Needs evidence
fields.question: What did youth workers actually tell you? Method, when, who you asked, and the main findings.
fields.helpText: Cite dates, sample size, and what people said. Do not invent survey results.

fields.label: EU priorities and Youth Goals
fields.question: Which EU youth priorities or Youth Goals do the activities actually deliver — not only tick?
fields.helpText: Inclusion, green, digital, and participation only where the programme really does that work.

fields.label: Objectives
fields.question: List SMART objectives that follow from the needs. Use the same numbers and titles in every later section.
fields.helpText: Each objective should be usable in daily youth work, not a personal-wellbeing slogan.

fields.label: Participant count
fields.question: How many youth workers will take part in the main activity (trainers not counted)?
fields.helpText: Up to 50 participants per activity. Use this same number in every section.

fields.label: Participant profile
fields.question: What is the profile of the youth workers (role, sending organisation, experience)?
fields.helpText: They must be people active in youth work in the participating organisations — not an open community call.

fields.label: Selection criteria
fields.question: How will you select participants? Named criteria, weightings, and who applies them.
fields.helpText: Published criteria and weightings. Not “we will select carefully”.

fields.label: Fewer opportunities
fields.question: Will participants with fewer opportunities take part? Which barriers, and what support?
fields.helpText: Name barriers and support measures — not a declaration that inclusion is important.

fields.label: Venue
fields.question: Where will the activity take place, and why that venue?
fields.helpText: Venue must be in a participating organisation’s country.

fields.label: Duration (days)
fields.question: How many consecutive activity days (excluding travel)?
fields.helpText: Eligible PDA duration: 2 to 60 consecutive days excluding travel.

fields.label: Dates
fields.question: What are the planned dates (month/year is enough if the exact days are not fixed)?

fields.label: Activity programme
fields.question: Outline the professional development activity (non-formal methods, sessions, how it serves the objectives).
fields.helpText: This is a training course / study visit / job-shadowing for youth workers — not a youth exchange, festival, or academic study trip.

fields.label: Non-formal methods
fields.question: Which non-formal methods will you use, and how do they match the learning outcomes?

fields.label: Preparatory visit
fields.question: Are you requesting a preparatory visit?
fields.helpText: An APV without a session plan will not be funded.

options.label: Yes — we have a day-by-day APV programme

fields.label: APV programme
fields.question: Paste or describe the APV session plan (who, when, what each session is for).

fields.label: Learning outcomes
fields.question: Knowledge, skills and attitudes. These must be usable in daily youth work.
fields.helpText: Not video production, startup consulting, or personal dopamine detox as the core outcome.

fields.label: Recognition
fields.question: How will learning be recognised (Youthpass, reflection sessions, certificates)?

fields.label: Preparation, implementation, follow-up
fields.question: What happens before, during and after — who does what, and how is each phase evaluated?

fields.label: Impact and dissemination
fields.question: Impact at the real scale of the activity, with target groups, channels, timeline and indicators.
fields.helpText: Name an expected change, an indicator, a measurement method, and a timeline. “Participants will become more aware” is not enough.

fields.label: Safety and insurance
fields.question: What safety, insurance, and safeguarding measures apply to participants?

fields.label: Evaluation
fields.question: How will you evaluate each phase, and which indicators match the real participant numbers?

fields.label: Management and communication
fields.question: Roles, communication, and how you will keep one project identity (title, numbers, objectives).

fields.label: Day-by-day timetable
fields.question: Paste or outline the day-by-day session plan for the main activity.
fields.helpText: Reviewers will not fund an activity without a session programme. Session count should match the duration in days.
